_notes: Avatars are generated in TWO stages:
Stage 1: rd_plus__default with references/_global.png as reference_images
â€” produces a neutral 96x96 standing pose in authentic Habbo style.
Stage 2: rd_advanced_animation__walking takes that pose as input_image,
returns a 192x192 sheet of 4 walk frames (2x2 grid).
Prompts explicitly call out the Habbo signatures (egg head, dot eyes, no mouth, dark outline).
Cost: ~0.03 + ~0.14 = ~0.17 per character. Single camera-facing direction only.
